long_biography.plain_text:
At the 2024 Pokémon World Championships in Honolulu, OnStage Hawaii supplied rigging and stage-production support across the Hawaii Convention Center and Hilton Hawaiian Village. The assignment illustrates the company's role in complex live and televised events.

Its public team includes specialists in lighting design, logistics, power distribution, scaffolding, LED systems and warehouse operations. The company also maintains equipment rental inventory for touring, convention and island-based productions. Brill's formal position combines executive leadership with responsibility for the corporation's administrative offices and registered-agent function. The corporation was formed in 2023 for event management and lighting-equipment services.
